title: "Decision Forest"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This example demonstrates a decision forest classifier using the `aoclda` package.

```{r library}
library(aoclda)
```

## Data

```{r data}
X_train <- matrix(
  c(
    0.0, 1.0,
    0.0, 1.0
  ),
  nrow = 2, ncol = 2
)
y_train <- c(0, 1)
X_test <- matrix(c(2., 2.), nrow = 1, ncol = 2)
y_test <- matrix(c(1), nrow = 1, ncol = 1)
```

## Fit and Predict

```{r forest}
forest <- decision_forest$new(seed = 988, n_trees = 100, criterion = "gini")
forest$fit(X_train, y_train)

pred <- forest$predict(X_test)
score <- forest$score(X_test, y_test)

cat(sprintf("Predictions: [%d]\n", pred[1]))
cat(sprintf("Score: %.3f\n", score))
```
